mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased corporate costs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY signals strong demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST YoY > 10%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% in 3 months signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 and RSAFS increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in 1 month signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25% in 1 month.
